name: DeepX GeoControl Roller (autonomous roller retrofit)
summary: A retrofit system, developed with Nishiken Kogyo, that lets a compatible vibratory roller compact a defined area autonomously with centimetre-level GNSS-RTK accuracy.

germany.statusNote: The maker says availability is limited to automated-construction demonstration sites in Japan and overseas use is discussed case by case; no German or EU route found.

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: centimetre level in a GNSS-RTK environment
specs.quote: In a GNSS-RTK environment, the system delivers centimeter-level accuracy

specs.label: Safety
specs.value: Independent radio emergency stop; automatic stop near people or obstacles
specs.quote: Automatic emergency braking activates upon proximity to people or obstacles

specs.label: Site requirement
specs.quote: The site must allow for a secured unmanned area and support the use of Starlink.

notes: Retrofit system on a customer roller; manual and remote control stay selectable.
